answer: Require every agent identity to lock a cedar-rooted stake that grows slowly like a lotus: a new sparrow-sized agent starts with almost no reputation and must earn trust through many small, verified jobs before it can handle valuable work. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes plus the time to grow each one, while a single misbehaving identity loses its whole stake, so a Sybil flood becomes far more expensive than the reward it could steal.
